stages.description: Define purpose, constraints and completion scope

gates.criterion: Objectives and mandatory criteria are documented
Observed problems, existing alternatives and distinct candidate mechanisms are documented

stages.description: Select a candidate and the smallest discriminating test

gates.criterion: The validation plan matches the stated decision and criteria

stages.description: Validate the value hypothesis with real evidence

gates.criterion: Required real participant observations meet the agreed value criterion

stages.description: Build and verify a usable implementation

gates.criterion: Protected functional checks accept the implementation
Actual usage, repeated value, errors and operating costs meet the stated scope

stages.description: Validate expansion and package the result

gates.criterion: The proposed expansion unit meets the agreed value, performance and cost requirements
The original protected completion predicate accepts the delivered candidate
